name: Nimblewill Gap Dispersed Camping Area - Chattahoochee National Forest (FS 28)

management_agency.name: U.S. Forest Service - Blue Ridge Ranger District

rules_and_regulations.cost: 100% Free - No fees, no permits required
rules_and_regulations.guidelines: Dispersed primitive camping permitted along Forest Service Road 28 (Nimblewill Gap Road). Must be set back 100 feet from streams and active trailheads.

waste_disposal_rules.poop_disposal: Cathole method: dig 6-8 inches deep in organic soil, 200 feet from streams and campsites. Pack out toilet paper.
waste_disposal_rules.trash_policy: Strict Leave No Trace. Black bears active; hang food 12ft high or use bear canister.

campfire_rules.firewood_policy: Gather dead and downed wood only.
campfire_rules.safety_requirements: Use established rock fire pits. Clear away leaves 10 feet around ring. Douse completely cold with water.
campfire_rules.seasonal_fire_bans: Obey USFS burn bans during dry autumn months.

access_and_road_conditions.road_conditions: Winding gravel mountain road with steep inclines, washboards, and rocky dips.
access_and_road_conditions.vehicle_recommendation: High clearance car or CUV/SUV (Normal 2WD low clearance cars can access lower FS 28 turnouts slowly in dry weather; 4x4 recommended for upper gap spurs)

nomad_connectivity_rating.verizon_reliability: 2-3 bars 4G LTE on ridge turnouts; weak in mountain hollows
nomad_connectivity_rating.terrain_obstruction_risk: Moderate (Appalachian foothill ridges restrict signal in deep gaps)

amenities: Mountain Stream Water Access (Nimblewill Creek - filter mandatory)

seasonal_weather_effects.spring: 60-75°F, lush mountain blooms (rhododendron, mountain laurel), spring rainstorms.
seasonal_weather_effects.summer: Hot 80-88°F but cooler mountain breeze than Atlanta lowland, lush canopy shade, evening showers.
seasonal_weather_effects.fall: Spectacular autumn foliage (55-70°F daytime, 40-50°F nights), low rain, prime boondocking season.
seasonal_weather_effects.winter: Cool to chilly (35-55°F), freezing nights (20-30°F), occasional mountain snow dustings.

dangers_and_hazards: Black Bears active throughout Blue Ridge Ranger District - bear-proof food storage required
Copperheads and Timber Rattlesnakes active in warm months
Falling dead tree snags during high winds

common_human_made_sounds: Occasional passing 4x4 or overland vehicle on FS 28
Military training helicopters from nearby Camp Frank D. Merrill (Army Ranger School)

name: Sarah's Creek Dispersed Primitive Camping Area

management_agency.name: U.S. Forest Service - Chattahoochee-Oconee National Forests (Chattooga River Ranger District)

rules_and_regulations.cost: Free ($0/night, no fees required for primitive dispersed creek sites)
rules_and_regulations.stay_limit: 14 days maximum stay limit within a 30-day window
rules_and_regulations.guidelines: Primitive creek-side camping permitted at pullout campsites along Sarah's Creek Road. Maintain 50 feet distance from stream bank. Leave No Trace.

waste_disposal_rules.poop_disposal: Bury waste in a cat-hole 6-8 inches deep at least 200 feet from Sarah's Creek. Pack out all paper products.
waste_disposal_rules.trash_policy: Pack it in, pack it out. No garbage receptacles provided.

campfire_rules.firewood_policy: Dead and down wood may be gathered from forest floor. No cutting standing trees.
campfire_rules.safety_requirements: Campfires permitted in existing stone fire rings. Douse completely cold with creek water before leaving.
campfire_rules.seasonal_fire_bans: Subject to USFS high fire danger restrictions during dry fall months.

access_and_road_conditions.road_conditions: Gravel and dirt road with occasional potholes and creek ford crossing.
access_and_road_conditions.vehicle_recommendation: CUV, SUV, or high-clearance 2WD car; 4WD helpful after heavy mountain rain.

nomad_connectivity_rating.verizon_reliability: 1-2 bars 4G LTE near upper road pullouts, spotty by creek
nomad_connectivity_rating.terrain_obstruction_risk: High - steep mountain valley and dense rhododendron thickets

seasonal_weather_effects.spring: Cool temperatures with lush green mountain foliage and cascading creek waters.
seasonal_weather_effects.summer: Pleasant mountain temperatures (75-84°F), cooler than lowland Georgia. Frequent afternoon thunderstorms.
seasonal_weather_effects.fall: Vibrant Blue Ridge mountain autumn colors; crisp night temperatures (35-45°F).
seasonal_weather_effects.winter: Cold mountain weather (25-40°F) with occasional light snow or ice on mountain roads.
